title: Beyond The Bedrock
description: Beyond The Bedrock Is A Some What Pyschological ARG Horror Mod That Is Meant To Corrupt Your Minecraft World, And Bring Many Entitys And Dimensions And Structures.                                why executer?
body:
![Main title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/74468c2a08bd5d3fb6225bf576e895d763151962.png)


_please note that this mod is now discontinued and will no longer recieve any further updates, neither bug fixes._


**_a new mod is in the works tho..._**


**It's 2017, You Really Want To Play Minecraft, So You Beg Your Parents To Buy It, But Its The Same Answer: No! Its Too Expensive And Times Are Tough Right Now. So You Walk Up To Your Bedroom Dissapointed And Just Keep Playing Other Games. Until One Late Night You Get An Idea! You Open Up Your Rusty Dusty Laptop And Search Up: Minecraft For Free. And Boom, First Website: Download Minecraft For Free Now! SO You Open It Excited, The Website Is Unverified And Very Sketchy, But You Dont Care, You Just Hover Your Mouse On The Big Shiny Green Download Button And Click It. Once Its Installed, You Open The Game, Enter Your Username, And You Create Your First World And Click Play, Not Knowing What Horrors Lie Ahead…**

**This Is Beyond The Bedrock, A Sorta Psycological, And Also A Horror Mod Made To Try To Recreate Those Scary Minecraft Args. It Adds Multiple Dimensions And Entitys And Structures. It Also Has Plenty Of Events Aswell! These Entitys And Admins Will Try To Haunt You And Even Corrupt Your World.**

**Do You Have What It Takes To Investigate Beyond The Caves And Bedrock?**

Im Also A Solo Dev So Updates And More Content May Take Some Time. If There Are Any Bugs Please Let Me Know In The Comments!

**_▶️Getting Started◀️_**

Once You Load In Your World, You May Notice Some Anomalys In The Sky Such As Floating Blocks And Maybe Even Some Diamonds! And Occasionally Youll See Floating Cube Outlines Similar To Wonderland.jar. Once You Have Geared Up And Have Enough Tools, You Might See A Gateway, And A Noisy Black Block In The Middle. Right Clicking It Takes You To One Of The Dimensions! This Dimension Is Heavily Inspired By Wonderland Aswell! In Order Too Exit Wait Till Night, And Sleep In A Bed. It Will Take You Back To The Overworld. And Also Upon Night Setting, Entitys Will Start Spawning, Not Right Away Tho. Just Play Your World Normally And Youll See...


:What This Mod Contains For Now:

4 Haunting Dimensions: A Safe Heaven, A Broken Memory, An Outdated Library, A Dreadful World.

8 Entitys: Watcher-1, Book Guardian, Sequencer, V, X, St3v1, 7832649, Sentry(88346).

16 Events,

5 Structures,

5 Blocks.

2 Achievements

If You Ever Want To Contribute To The Project Please Leave Some Suggestions In The Comments!

This Mod Is One Of My Very First Projects! So If There Are Some Bugs Or Issues Please Let Me Know In The Comments!

Mods That Inspired Me To Make This Project: Misplaced, Beyond The Skybox, The Broken Script, Wonderland.jar, no.moon.jar, untitled.log. Please Go And Check Out These Wonderful And Amazing Mods That Inspired Me!

If You Ever Have Made A Video Or Our Planning On Making A Video, Please Let Me Know! I Always Enjoy Watching Other People Play This Mod! Thanks :) 

Why Should You Download Beyond The Bedrock?:

This Mod Adds Plenty Of Content And Entitys. And It Gives You The Feeling Of Being Watched, And That Your Not Alone... It Also Trys To Recreate Those Minecraft ARG Videos You Sometimes See, And Trys To Make You The Main Protaganist! Its Also Very Compatible With Other Mods And Modpacks Making Great For An Even Scarier Experience! This Mod Is Constantly Being Updated, Tho Some Updates May Take Time.

And If You Read All Of This, Thanks :)
